title: November 1 — Nopee and NopeeClaude: two different video-speed probes
summary: Two independent November 1 experiments responding to neuron-inspired centre-surround filtering and leaky temporal dynamics. Nopee is a tiny trained frame-forecasting comparison with a negative whole-frame DoG/E-I result; NopeeClaude probes actual Wan2.2 sampling and caching costs, stopping before adapter training when reduced-step samples diverged. Neither tests measured biological constants.

nodes.claim: Standalone 32×32 moving-shapes frame predictor with shared learned transport base and fixed, learned, or shuffled difference-of-Gaussians plus leaky E/I feature-memory branches; includes Gradio demo and interventions.
nodes.survived: The runnable offline predictor and provenance ledger isolate a real recurrent feature pathway: two refinement calls on 12 held-out toy worlds give adapter-off whole-frame MSE 0.03390, fixed 0.03765 and learned 0.03887. Bypassing spatial filtering lowers learned-adapter MSE to 0.02522.
nodes.killed: The full DoG/E-I branch worsens overall error and runtime versus the matched no-adapter base; resetting memory also improves the adapters in this run. One training seed, synthetic constants, tiny toy worlds and post-development design choices do not demonstrate biological specificity or video-model speedup.
nodes.era: November 1: video prediction and sampling controls

nodes.claim: Preregistered Wan2.2-TI2V-5B budget probe compares fewer generation steps with 40-step reference and FirstBlockCache before testing small DoG/E-I-inspired latent or in-block adapters.
nodes.survived: Source-reported 12-prompt validation: six steps run in 13.9 s but often lose objects; 12 steps in 27.7 s are far from the 40-step reference. Separate three-prompt caching sweep reports 40 steps with cache 0.3 in 28.3 s or cache 0.5 in 21.5 s, with smaller latent disagreement than 12-step sampling.
nodes.killed: The planned adapter-training comparison was paused before training; it did not demonstrate that any adapter repairs cheap sampling. The reference used off-design 320×576 resolution, and cache and step-budget comparisons used different prompt subsets. No actual neuron-derived constants or general quality-equivalence claim.

edges.why: Nopee explicitly credits Antti's Sihti / Janus / SignalIsASignal discussions as motivation for its separate DoG + temporal-memory experiment; no code inheritance is claimed.
Independent small-model forecasting and Wan sampler/caching probes of the same neuron-inspired adapter question, not a software fork or evidence one improves the other.

motifs.title: A neuron-inspired adapter must beat a matched ordinary control before its source constants matter
motifs.description: Nopee's synthetic DoG/E-I memory harms overall toy prediction while bypassing the spatial filter helps. NopeeClaude finds caching a more promising speed lever than dropping Wan steps, before adapter training. Mechanistic recurrence is not evidence of biological specificity or competitive generation.
